faq.q: Чи є сенс приєднуватися ближче до кінця події?

en.summary: A futures trading contest on BYDFi for registered users who pass KYC (identity verification): three leaderboards with a total pool of 100,000 USDT in Futures Bonus. The rules state no overall cap per person. By the formula, 1st place on the Profit or ROI leaderboard pays at most 3,300 USDT on each, and prizes from several leaderboards can be combined.
steps: Register a BYDFi account and complete the required KYC verification. The rules give no separate deadline for this, but the event runs until 2026/12/01 00:00 (UTC+8), which is 30 November 16:00 UTC.
Hold assets equivalent to at least 100 USDT in your Futures Account. The rules do not say when or for how long this balance is checked.
Register through the event page (the announcement says Join Now). Without a successful registration you cannot take part or get rewards. No separate registration deadline is given.
For the Profit and ROI leaderboards: reach a cumulative futures trading volume of at least 500 USDT during the event, 2026/10/31 00:00 – 2026/12/01 00:00 (UTC+8), and finish in the top 10.
For the Daily Trading Volume leaderboard: reach at least 500 USDT in futures trading volume on the day you are competing, and finish in that day's top 3.

payout.when: Daily Trading Volume leaderboard: rewards for the previous week are distributed every Wednesday. Profit and ROI leaderboards: after the event ends and final data verification is completed, with no exact date given. The rules mention no claim deadline.
payout.form: All rewards are issued as Futures Bonus. The rules do not say whether it can be withdrawn, so check the bonus terms on the exchange before counting on cash. The Profit and ROI leaderboards have 30,000 USDT each: 1st 6,600 USDT, 2nd 5,400 USDT, 3rd 3,600 USDT, 4th–6th share 8,400 USDT, 7th–10th share 6,000 USDT. These are pools for each rank, not fixed payouts: your own reward comes from a formula. Daily leaderboard: 40,000 USDT ÷ number of event days, split 50% for 1st, 30% for 2nd and 20% for 3rd.
payout.how: Check your BYDFi Futures Account and the relevant rewards pages for reward credits and the Bonus usage rules. The rules do not say whether you need to claim anything manually.

watch: The promo headline (5% Rebate, BTC Airdrop, 0 Fees) does not match the rules text, which only describes a futures contest called the Autumn Futures Challenge. Nothing in this text confirms a rebate, a BTC airdrop or zero fees.
Only the leaders get paid: the top 10 on Profit and ROI, and the top 3 each day on volume. Meeting the minimum requirements alone guarantees nothing.
For 1st, 2nd and 3rd place on Profit and ROI, the formula pays at most half of the listed pool, because each of the two shares is capped at 50%.
The 500 USDT requirement for the daily leaderboard applies to each day separately. The rules do not state outright that a day is counted in UTC+8, although the event period is given in that timezone.
Validity period, eligible uses, offset rules and expiration of the Futures Bonus depend on the platform's general rules, which are not included here.
BYDFi can disqualify users and revoke rewards for cheating, wash trading (trading with yourself to inflate volume), bulk account registrations or other abuse.
Futures trading can lose you more than any prize is worth, and chasing volume adds costs. The rules do not list trading fees, so check them on the exchange.
The text does not say which futures pairs count or whether any countries are excluded. If language versions differ, the English one prevails.

faq.q: What is the most one person can get?
faq.a: The rules set no overall limit. By the formula, 1st place on Profit or ROI pays up to 3,300 USDT, while one person in the 4th–6th tier could in theory get up to 4,200 USDT (8,400 × 50% × (50% + 50%)). Daily volume prizes come on top. This is our own calculation, and everything is paid in Futures Bonus.

faq.q: How is my reward on the Profit and ROI leaderboards calculated?
faq.a: Tier pool × 50% × (your volume share + your performance share), compared with users in the same rank tier. Each share is capped at 50%. Example: in the 4th–6th tier with a 40% volume share and a 30% profit share, you get 8,400 × 50% × 70% = 2,940 USDT.

faq.q: How much does the daily volume leaderboard pay per day?
faq.a: The rules do not state the number of days, but the event dates span 31. That makes the daily pool about 1,290 USDT: roughly 645 USDT for 1st, 387 for 2nd and 258 for 3rd. This is our calculation and depends on how the exchange counts the days.

faq.q: Can I win on several leaderboards at once?
faq.a: Yes. The rules say eligible users can earn rewards from multiple leaderboards. You need to meet the volume requirement for each one.

faq.q: What is ROI and how is it different from profit?
faq.a: Profit is the amount you made. ROI shows the return relative to what you put in, usually as a percentage. The text does not explain exactly how BYDFi calculates ROI for this contest.

faq.q: Do trades made before I register on the event page count?
faq.a: The rules do not say. It is safer to register on the event page first and trade afterwards.

faq.q: Is it worth joining close to the end of the event?
faq.a: The rules do not forbid late registration, but they give no registration deadline either. The daily leaderboard is counted separately for each day. Profit and ROI are counted over the whole event, so people who started earlier may find it easier to build a result there.
